title: Good gameplay, but the "Star-up" system ruins the experience!
body:
The overall game concept and mechanics are fine, but the 'Star-up' system is incredibly frustrating and completely outdated.
Here are the major issues that need immediate fixing:
 Extremely Slow Upgrades: Starring up players takes an absurd amount of time. For example, doing a 3rd or 4th star-up for a 4-star player takes an entire week!
 Players Become Unavailable: The most illogical part is that the player is completely locked and cannot be used in matches during this entire week-long upgrade process.
 Outdated Mechanics: In modern gaming, merging or starring up characters is almost always an instant action. Locking away a player's best assets for 7 days is just bad game design and kills the pacing.

title: Extremely disappointed about new update
body:
Hello Hitwicket Team,

I have been playing Hitwicket for a long time and have invested hundreds of hours into building my team. I have always supported the game and even took the time to send detailed suggestions because I genuinely wanted it to improve.

Unfortunately, after the recent updates, I feel like the game has become unfair rather than more balanced.

Here are my biggest concerns:

1. The game no longer feels skill-based. Many matches feel predetermined instead of rewarding good strategy and team building.
2. Shot percentages seem meaningless. My World Class batters like Gill have over 80% shot probability, yet they frequently fail to connect. Meanwhile, opponents with much weaker batters and shot power below 60% confidently hit boundaries against bowlers like Rabada. This makes player stats feel unreliable.
3. Progression has become frustrating. I worked hard to reach Legendary and Supreme levels, but after the update my reputation dropped back to Masterful. It feels like months of progress were taken away overnight.
4. Player balancing feels unfair. Even the base power of my strongest players, including Gill and Hussey, has been reduced. Instead of rewarding long-term players, the update makes our teams feel weaker.
5. The game increasingly feels pay-to-win. I understand premium purchases should offer convenience, but they should not make free-to-play players feel like they can never compete fairly. Right now, it feels as though paying players receive a significant gameplay advantage rather than just faster progression.

I don’t mind losing matches. I have accepted defeats many times when I felt the better team or better strategy won.

What I cannot accept is feeling that my decisions, upgrades, and months of progression matter less than hidden balancing changes.

This is genuinely disappointing because I enjoyed building my franchise and recommending this game to others.

Unless these issues are addressed and the game becomes more transparent and balanced, I have decided to stop playing.

I hope the team seriously considers the concerns of long-term players because a fair and rewarding experience is what keeps a community alive.

Thank you.

title: Stay from this Game
body:
I have been playing Hitwicket since 2024. I spent thousands of rupees on this game, including purchasing the ₹1000 Season Pass every month, and spent years building my team one player at a time.

Sadly, I regret every rupee I spent.

Ranked matchmaking is terrible. My Level 85–89 team is constantly matched against Level 100 teams, making months of hard work meaningless.

The game is also full of technical problems:

Server disconnects during matches.

Random freezing.

Mobile overheating.

Poor optimization.

Even 90% chance shots miss at crucial moments, making the gameplay feel frustrating instead of rewarding.


Every month, new players with overpowered traits are released for ₹3,000, ₹5,000, ₹10,000, and even ₹15,000. Instead of fixing the game's major issues, it feels like the developers have become more focused on monetization than on improving the player experience.

In my experience, if you don't keep spending money, progression becomes painfully slow and it's difficult to play more than a handful of meaningful matches each day.

I have cancelled my subscription and requested that my account be permanently deleted.

Warning to new players: Read the recent reviews carefully before downloading this game or spending any money. There are many games that provide a fairer experience and better value. I wish I had known this before investing my time and money.

title: The game has completely lost its balance
body:
The biggest problem with Hitwicket right now is the complete lack of balance and competitiveness between bat and ball.
How is it acceptable that 2-star or 3-star opposition players consistently outperform 4-star and 5-star players, even when you’re batting sensibly, building an innings, and avoiding blind slogging? It makes player progression and team-building feel almost meaningless.
What’s even more frustrating is the team composition. How can you allow Snap and Hex in the same team and call it “balanced”? Or let bowling lineups stack 3–4 Hex players and still claim there’s a fair contest between bat and ball? It completely destroys competitive integrity.
I’ve played over 4,000 matches, so this isn’t a knee-jerk reaction after a few unlucky games. I’ve invested a huge amount of time into this game because I genuinely enjoyed it. But instead of improving, the balancing decisions have become increasingly frustrating.
I’m honestly irritated by these fundamental design choices. It feels like skill, strategy, and careful gameplay matter far less than arbitrary balancing decisions.

This is the point where I walk away. I quit.

title: Excellent game with some bugs
body:
Hi,

The game and gameplay are exceptionally good and fun, but the stats and score-recording bugs are seriously spoiling the experience.

Earlier, the half-century and century count was wrong. Now, those features seem to be gone, and even the runs scored in previous matches are showing incorrect values or not getting saved properly. What is the point of having these features if the data is wrong?

The Man of the Match selection in PvP also feels broken. If the user bats last, a batsman usually gets the award. But when the user is bowling, even if a batsman contributes more, they still don’t seem to get Man of the Match.

Honestly, you have built a splendid game, but silly bugs like this slipping through QA really hurts the full gameplay experience. For now, I’m giving 1 star because these issues are frustrating.

title: Плохой сетевой код и реклама
body:

Очень много рекламы, я все понимаю, всем кушать хочется, но в игре, которая построена на том, что тебя вынуждают платить практически за все, добавлять рекламу через каждую вторую, а иногда и каждую, игру — перебор (вначале такого нет, заманивают).
En: The game is based on multiplayer, so if you crash, it's an automatic defeat, and you won't be able to return.

body: Everyday my mostly lvl 11 team with a few 12s plays complete lvl 14 teams. On the occasion I’m playing somebody at my level, I make errors and see glitches to lose games. I quit most of my games as most games feel predetermined. If the first play is an error or glitch it’s not worth finishing. Plus the rewards now are terrible. They’re not worth the time it takes to open the chests (which feels like it’s getting longer and longer). And don’t get me started on the percentage of getting players being equal garbage. I get the same stupid players over and over and over and over. I just quit a fixed game. My first pitch was outside the zone. It was hit to the SS who made an error. This game I knew was fixed so I gave up. It was too obvious that I had no chance to win, so I quit. This game sucks nowadays.

title: Great game BUT…….
body:
It’s a great game, but I think the team tracking system needs to be adjusted.

When teams in the Death Bracket are consistently playing the other top teams, everyone should receive Gold Cards. Every match is against elite competition, and those teams are constantly battling each other. It doesn’t make sense to reward some while penalizing others simply because they’re all facing the toughest opponents available.

The current system ends up hurting the most competitive teams. Over time, it becomes a team killer. Players get frustrated when their effort isn’t properly rewarded, which leads to people leaving teams or even quitting the game altogether.

Reward the difficulty of the competition, not just the outcome. That would make the system feel much fairer and help keep the game’s best players engaged.

title: Used to be great. Now you have to pay to win
body:
This used to be one of my favorite and only downtime mobile baseball games. It was fun because skill, strategy, and smart upgrades actually mattered. Lately, though, it feels like the game has become heavily pay-to-win.

If you don’t spend money on premium bats, uniforms, and player upgrades, you’re at a huge disadvantage. Matchmaking often feels stacked against free-to-play players, and progression has become more about your wallet than your ability.

I don’t mind games offering cosmetic purchases or optional boosts, but when paying becomes the deciding factor in who wins, the competitive aspect disappears. It’s disappointing because the gameplay itself is still great. I hope the developers bring the balance back and reward skill instead of spending.

title: BEWARE Cheaters
body: Once you get to the Bronze and Silver leagues the game is rampant with cheaters. Every ball outside the strike zone, no matter how close, will not be swung at by your opponent. Every ball within the strike zone will be swung at and be a hit (usually a double in the gap or a bloop single. EVERYTIME). The game is fun, but it’s ruined by cheaters. Their method of reporting cheaters is flawed too. They expect you to document evidence of cheating and email them. Do they expect us to constantly be taking screenshots throughout the game (which would cause a dsync), or screen record every game? How can a screenshot of someone taking a ball or getting multiple hits in the gap be evidence of cheating? I’ve never seen a game make it so difficult to catch cheaters before.

title: Money grab, glitchy
body:
DO NOT GET THIS GAME! I JUST DELETED IT FROM MY PHONE. IT IS GIANT PAY TO WIN SCAM. YOU WILL ALWAYS LOSE TO THOSE THAT PAY TO GET AND MAX OUT THEIR CARDS. SKILL HAS ZERO FACTORS WHEN UP AGAINST MAXED OUT TEAMS. 

This game would actually be good if it wasn’t for the fact that upgrading cards increases their performance and the fact that people can just pay to square the cards needed to upgrade them. It’s fun at first until you get to the upper leagues and 90% of the players paid to max their teams out.  

After a certain point skill is no longer a factor it’s all about upgrades and special skills, the gold card players have the most powerful skill and the most efficient way to level those is through paying for them as there are very few ways to get them through natural gameplay.
The game was fun until I got to the point where everyone had fully gold team fully upgraded and I’m stuck facing them with lower tier cards that are upgraded to the same level. Now the game is just aggravating because the other team gets home runs every time they graze the ball while I’m stuck having to run all the bases. And my fielders are slow while theirs can retrieve and throw the balls extremely fast.

On top of that it has game breaking glitches. For example if you get a banner notification on your phone in the middle of the game, the game loses server connection and instead of pausing or forgetting the match it just continues without you as if you were just not interacting with it, letting your opponent make unchallenged strike outs if pitching or easy base hits if batting putting them in a massive lead, and when you lose a match you get penalized you don’t just not move up, you move back.
